title: Atomic WOFOST Crop-Owner and Accepted-Event Receipt Transaction Qualification

architecture.commit_authority: existing F-KT kernel candidate and commit only
architecture.transaction_state: WOFOST-specific runtime transaction_state_t containing the physical crop owner plus compact last-consumed accepted-event identity receipt
architecture.event_identity: opaque source provenance derived from the frozen F-WOF34 accepted crop-event token
architecture.atomic_publication: crop-owner candidate and matching event-consumption receipt are fields of one F-KT candidate and are published by one F-KT commit

qualified_properties: rejected physical trial contributes zero to the crop event carrier
accepted physical event yields the exact frozen carrier
precommit crop owner and receipt remain unchanged
same crop checkpoint replays an identical owner-plus-receipt candidate
rollback leaves both crop owner and receipt at the checkpoint
one F-KT revision publishes crop owner and matching receipt together
legacy event_delivered is not a second commit authority on this route
duplicate source event causes zero additional crop advancement
failed crop evolution causes zero owner or receipt mutation
fixed one-day crop event forbids retry dt shrinking
F-WOF33 two-phase crop-window regression remains green

gate_E_failed_then_accepted_retry.oracle: qualification-only overlay on the already-qualified main F-WOF38 harness
properties: an intentionally failed crop trial leaves the committed crop transaction at revision 0
the retry starts from the same still-committed crop checkpoint and the same accepted physical source event
the valid retry produces the same crop owner as the direct qualified path
the retry remains candidate-only until explicit F-KT commit
one successful commit advances the committed transaction to exactly revision 1
the committed receipt is ready and matches the accepted source event

qualification_discovered_hardening.finding: GNU Fortran O2 with strict warnings exposed logical expressions that combined impure validation calls with .and.; Fortran does not guarantee short-circuit evaluation.
qualification_discovered_hardening.repair: replace compiler-dependent logical chains in ready/validation paths by explicit sequential guards
qualification_discovered_hardening.semantic_effect: evaluation order is explicit and compiler-independent; no physics or acceptance tolerance was changed

water_and_mass.crop_transaction_water_ledger: complete zero-water ledger because PTRA/QROT water accounting remains owned by the already-qualified physical F-WOF36 path

not_qualified: restart or crash durability of an active accepted crop window and crop transaction receipt
persistent serialization format for the receipt
mixed use of the legacy commit_wofost_crop_event_delivery path with the new atomic receipt path
runtime cleanup or lifecycle retirement semantics for a legacy accepted window after atomic receipt commit
arbitrary multi-day single-call WOFOST crop evolution
full MultiSWAP memory-layout, SoA or batching qualification of the new WOFOST transaction state
canonical promotion of the F-WOF38 branch
potential WOFOST shadow, nutrients, soybean, grass, oxygen IALPWET or other optional WOFOST routes outside the inherited restricted scope
